notes: EP: the genome-wide promoter capture Hi-C sample EP_genomewide.chinput on the CHiCAGO hg19 HindIII design; K562: ENCODE K562 promoter capture Hi-C replicates 1 and 2 (HiCUP + bam2chicago on the same design). Fragment-level cools (one variable-size bin per HindIII fragment) from hicConvertFormat --inputFormat chinput, chromosomes kept with the 3.7.6 hicAdjustMatrix (derive_capture.sh). Bait-to-bait pixels hold N once (the two chinput rows of a pair carry the same N; the larger where they differ); identical input on both sides. One bait on both matrices and combined (three images).
